department: School of Life and Environmental Sciences

deadline.value: Applications are accepted all year; the RTP stipend has earlier dates that the fetched page does not show as text.
deadline.quote: Postgraduate research degree applications are open all year round, with most research intakes starting in Research Period 2 (March) and Research Period 3 (July).

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE is mentioned on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: You must secure a supervisor before you apply, with evidence that a primary supervisor agreed to supervise you.
supervisor.quote: Before submitting your application, you must secure a supervisor.

also.quote: Evidence that a primary supervisor has agreed to supervise you.

funding.value: Stipends are competitive and awarded on merit; international students pay tuition unless a scholarship package covers it.
funding.quote: These competitive stipends are awarded based on academic merit and research potential.

entry_route.value: A first-class honours bachelor's degree or a master's with a substantial research component is usually needed.
entry_route.quote: a bachelor's degree with first-class honours, or | a master's degree performed at a high academic standard, which includes a substantial component of research

notes: One school covers life and environmental sciences, per the Science postgraduate page list.
